responsibility: First-launch onboarding flow: welcome page (echo-memory-canvas §15.2), PIPL privacy consent summary + equal agree/decline (US-PRV-008 AC-1~3), permission sequence with iCloud download prompt (US-SRC-001 AC-6), language selection with zh-Hans mapping hint (US-SYN-001 AC-2), first model load progress (§15.6) driven by real ModelLoaderActor (3F.3) with modelLoadError/modelUnavailable recovery (US-RES-004), declined exit state. AC-4 consent persistence wired to ConsentStoreActor (3F.1) and AC-5 deregistration = transactional purge via AppComposition.revokeConsent (3F.1); Settings withdraw-consent entry full UI wiring lands in 3F.7.

inputs.privacySummary: PIPL privacy policy summary with purpose/method/kind/retention/local-processing statement (US-PRV-008 AC-2)
inputs.permissionSteps: Ordered permission sequence: photos -> notifications -> location -> health (echo-memory-canvas §15.4)
inputs.icloudDownloadPrompt: US-SRC-001 AC-6 first photo permission download-and-keep-original hint with Open Settings button
inputs.languages: zh-Hans | en-US picker (US-SYN-001 AC-2); traditional/other mapped to zh-Hans with one-time hint
inputs.modelLoadProgress: Determinate progress for first model load (§15.6); driven by ModelLoaderActor.overallStatus (3F.3), no fixture fallback in production

outputs.visibleContent: 5-step TabView flow (welcome -> privacy consent -> permissions -> language -> model loading) presented as fullScreenCover; declined state on PIPL refuse
outputs.interactionTargets: onboarding-start, onboarding-privacy-agree, onboarding-privacy-decline, onboarding-permission-allow, onboarding-permission-deny, onboarding-open-settings, onboarding-language-zh, onboarding-language-en, onboarding-begin-load, onboarding-declined-close
outputs.accessibilityTree: Step indicator announced; privacy summary scrollable; agree/decline equally prominent (US-PRV-008 AC-3); language picker with selected checkmark

systemContainer: fullScreenCover + TabView (step pages) + Form (language picker) + ProgressView (model loading)
fallbackConditions: FullScreenCover so system back is disabled; explicit Continue/Decline navigation only
